title: DarkMusic 1.4.8 Release
changelog:
• Persistent Quick Settings Media Player under notification center (stays active even when app is closed)
• Completely overhauled Share Lyrics UI: full scrollable lyrics list with pinned bottom action bar
• True original studio sound in 30s lyrics video (256kbps lossless PCM pipeline, zero robotic artifacts)
• In-app player identical lyrics typography (50f bold) & AMLL soft-edge wipe karaoke animation
